camel_example: aliyun polardb UnbindResourceControl --region cn-hangzhou --TargetValue app_user --DBClusterId 'pc-00000000000000' --TargetType USER --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ResourceControlName test_rc
description_en: Unbinds a specified resource control rule from a user, database, query, or connection in a PolarDB for MySQL cluster. After the unbinding is successful, the resource control rule no longer limits the CPU quota of the corresponding target object
description_zh: 解除指定资源控制规则与 PolarDB MySQL 集群中用户、数据库、查询或连接之间的绑定关系。解绑成功后，该资源控制规则不再限制对应目标对象的 CPU 配额
kebab_example: aliyun polardb unbind-resource-control --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --resource-control-name test_rc --target-type USER --target-value app_user --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnbindResourceControl

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the PolarDB cluster.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
PolarDB 集群所在地域的 ID。
您可以通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html查看地域ID详情
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource control rule. The name must be 1 to 63 ASCII bytes in length, start with a letter, and can contain only letters, digits, and underscores
parameters.help_zh: 资源控制规则名称。长度为 1～63 个 ASCII 字节，必须以英文字母开头，仅支持英文字母、数字和下划线
parameters.name: resource_control_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the target to unbind. Valid values: USER, DATABASE, QUERY, CONNECTION. The value is case-insensitive
parameters.help_zh: 解绑目标的类型。取值：USER、DATABASE、QUERY、CONNECTION，大小写不敏感
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en: The value of the target to unbind. The format is the same as the TargetValue for the corresponding target type in the BindResourceControl operation
parameters.help_zh: 解绑目标的值，格式与 BindResourceControl 中对应目标类型的 TargetValue 相同
parameters.name: target_value
